US To Sell $44 Bln In 7-Year Notes Thu
WASHINGTON (Dow Jones)--The U.S. Treasury plans to auction $44 billion in 7-year notes Thursday.
The debt will settle on Sept. 30, 2026 and will mature Sept. 30, 2033.
The Federal Reserve holds $30.411 billion of maturing securities for its own account. Amounts bid by the Federal Reserve banks for their own account will be in addition to the public offering amount.

Noncompetitive tenders for the 7-year notes, available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 12:00 PM Eastern Time Thursday. Competitive tenders available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 1:00 PM Eastern Time.
(Data provided by the U.S. Treasury Dept.)
